title: Kissed Noodle Dish
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese noodle dish made with kissed australian beef and noodles.
instructions: 1. Cook the kissed noodles according to the package instructions.
2. In a large pan or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil over medium-high heat.
3. Add the sliced australian beef and cook until browned.
4. Add the soy sauce, sesame seeds, and honey to the pan and stir to combine.
5. Add the cooked noodles to the pan and toss to combine with the sauce.
6. Sprinkle with green onions and ginger.
8. Garnish with additional green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
9. Cook the ginger for a few seconds until fragrant.
10. Stir-fry everything together for 1-2 minutes until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
